facts.business: Vishnu Chemicals Limited manufactures speciality and inorganic chemicals, including Strontium Carbonate, for magnets, electronics, advanced industrial applications, batteries, aerospace, defence, and renewable energy sectors.
key_risks: Geopolitical tensions impacting logistics costs, raw material movement, freight availability and customer inventory planning
Tariff uncertainties and cautious industrial demand influencing customer procurement behaviour
Volatility in commodity prices, energy markets, and global logistics
